escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: handlebars ≤4.7.8 allows template injection through AST type confusion, partial block tampering, and prototype pollution. 8 CVEs including GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q.

escalations.title: protobufjs RCE & Prototype Pollution (11 CVEs, CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: protobufjs has 11 CVEs including arbitrary code execution via crafted protobuf messages, prototype pollution, and unbounded recursion DoS. Present in portal/Backend via gRPC/OpenTelemetry chain.

escalations.title: Vitest UI Arbitrary File Read/Execute (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: vitest <3.2.6 UI server allows arbitrary file read and execution when the UI server is accessible. Affects Source/Frontend, portal/Backend, portal/Frontend.
escalations.fix: Upgrade vitest to >=3.2.6 on all projects; disable Vitest UI in production

p2_findings.title: Direct store access from route handlers
p2_findings.description: Three route files (workItems.ts, workflow.ts, intake.ts) call store.* functions directly, bypassing the service layer. CLAUDE.md mandates 'No direct DB calls from route handlers'.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract a workItemService.ts wrapping CRUD store calls. Move changeHistory mutation in approve/reject/dispatch into the service layer.

p2_findings.title: GET /api/search not wired — FR-dependency-search unimplemented
p2_findings.description: FR-dependency-search requires a cross-entity typeahead endpoint. A test file exists that explicitly documents the route is missing and will fail. No route file exists in src/routes/.
p2_findings.recommendation: Implement src/routes/search.ts with GET /api/search?q=, register in app.ts, return {data: WorkItem[]}.

p2_findings.title: Missing dependencyCheckDuration histogram metric
p2_findings.description: FR-dependency-metrics specifies dependency_check_duration_seconds histogram. It is absent from metrics.ts. The gap is also untested.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add dependencyCheckDurationHistogram to metrics.ts; instrument isReady() in dependency.ts; add test case.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer has 11 FR-dependency-* requirements untracked
p2_findings.description: 11 implemented FR-dependency-* requirements are not in the enforcer's requirements file. The enforcer passes even when requirements are missing (QO-002 is evidence).
p2_findings.recommendation: Add FR-dependency-* requirements to requirements.md or create a new plan file. Add a failing test for GET /api/search.

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: form-data 4.0.0–4.0.5 allows CRLF injection in multipart boundary handling. Affects 3 projects.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade form-data to >=4.0.6 across all affected projects.

p2_findings.title: Vite server.fs.deny path traversal bypass
p2_findings.description: Vite dev server has a path traversal vulnerability allowing bypass of server.fs.deny restrictions. Affects Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend.

p2_findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js DoS via malformed compressed messages (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: grpc-js crashes on malformed compressed messages, enabling denial of service. Present in portal/Backend via OpenTelemetry.

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry SDK cascade — severely outdated (v0.47 → v0.220)
p2_findings.description: portal/Backend's OpenTelemetry packages are 173 major versions behind (0.47.0 vs current 0.220.0), carrying 46 moderate CVEs through the transitive chain.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade full OpenTelemetry stack to latest. Consider switching from auto-instrumentations to selective manual instrumentation to reduce dependency surface.

p3_findings.title: Dual logger abstraction with incompatible calling conventions
p3_findings.recommendation: Standardise on one calling convention; remove src/logger.ts shim.

p3_findings.title: Duplicate frontend test files at two directory locations
p3_findings.recommendation: Canonicalise on tests/pages/ (more complete); delete root-level duplicates.

p3_findings.title: OpenTelemetry tracing absent from backend (CLAUDE.md mandate)
p3_findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node, @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node; initialise before route setup; propagate traceparent.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable suppressions without justification comments
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline comments explaining why react-hooks/exhaustive-deps is suppressed at each location.

p3_findings.title: 69 moderate CVEs across 5 npm projects
p3_findings.description: Moderate CVEs spread across Source/Backend (uuid, esbuild), Source/Frontend (postcss, react-router), portal/Backend (OpenTelemetry chain, qs, body-parser), portal/Frontend (postcss, react-router, esbuild).
p3_findings.recommendation: Address as part of phased dependency upgrade (Phase 2 — 1 week). Run npm audit fix --force only after testing.

p4_findings.title: 3 low-severity CVEs
p4_findings.description: Low-severity CVEs in transitive dependencies with minimal exploitability.
